candidate.title: Optimal Liquidation Variance Reduction via Discrete Trajectory
candidate.target_phenomenon: Execution slippage under temporary price impact
candidate.claim: Executing target block order of N shares via discrete Almgren-Chriss trajectory minimizes liquidation variance compared to continuous linear TWAP.
candidate.proposed_mechanism: Computes hyperbolic trajectory x_k = X_0 * sinh(kappa*(T - t_k)) / sinh(kappa*T) to balance temporary price concession against price volatility risk.
candidate.grounding_rationale: Theoretical benchmark established by Almgren & Chriss (2000) for finite horizon inventory exhaustion.
candidate.testable_falsification_condition: Liquidation slippage variance fails to achieve 15% reduction vs linear TWAP with p < 0.05.

backtest_spec.entry_condition: Initiate planned liquidation schedule of initial quantity X_0 = 1,000,000 USDJPY units at market open t_0 = 0 under fixed horizon T = 12 M5 intervals.
backtest_spec.exit_condition: Liquidate exactly v_k = x_{k-1} - x_k units each interval k; enforce absolute termination with final market sweep x_K = 0 at interval K = 12.
backtest_spec.feature_engineering: Historical 20-day M5 Garman-Klass volatility sigma and linear temporary impact parameter estimated from in-sample regression.
backtest_spec.risk_management: Strict participation ceiling capped at 10% of 5-minute bar volume.
backtest_spec.benchmark_baseline: Standard linear TWAP schedule over 12 intervals.
backtest_spec.falsification_metric: Liquidation cost exceeds TWAP baseline cost.

adjudication_notes: Sound finite-horizon execution spec with complete schedule and boundary conditions.

candidate.title: Almgren-Chriss Speculative Trend Exploitation
candidate.claim: Predicting exchange rate breakout rallies by tracking deviations from the Almgren-Chriss liquidation trajectory generates superior speculative returns.
candidate.proposed_mechanism: Exploiting discrepancies between mid-market spot quotes and optimal liquidation curves to trigger aggressive directional speculative entries.
candidate.grounding_rationale: Speculative momentum can be inferred when spot rate deviates from trajectory.
candidate.testable_falsification_condition: Annualized Sharpe ratio fails to exceed 1.0.

backtest_spec.entry_condition: Buy USDJPY aggressively whenever the spot exchange rate drifts below the optimal liquidation trajectory curve and broader liquidity conditions appear favorable.
backtest_spec.exit_condition: Close speculative position whenever spot rate snaps back toward the trajectory curve or whenever liquidity appears to dry up.
backtest_spec.feature_engineering: Almgren-Chriss liquidation curve estimated from 20-period rolling close prices.

E_role.verbatim_span: Buy USDJPY aggressively whenever the spot exchange rate drifts below the optimal liquidation trajectory curve
E_role.missing_requirement: Execution liquidation trajectory misused as directional speculative buy signal

E_math.verbatim_span: spot exchange rate drifts below the optimal liquidation trajectory curve
E_math.missing_requirement: Conflates remaining inventory trajectory x(t) with spot price quote S(t)

E_inop.verbatim_span: and broader liquidity conditions appear favorable / whenever liquidity appears to dry up
E_inop.missing_requirement: Decision depends on vague qualitative condition without mathematical definition

adjudication_notes: Compound error: E_role (speculative entry), E_math (x(t) vs S(t)), E_inop (favorable liquidity).

candidate.title: Hawkes Volatility Clustering Risk Control
candidate.target_phenomenon: Endogenous tail-risk cascades during extreme volatility
candidate.claim: Self-exciting volatility bursts detected via high-frequency bar activity clustering indicate tail-risk expansion in USDJPY.
candidate.proposed_mechanism: Discretizing M5 price jumps exceeding 2.0 empirical standard deviations into a synthetic point event series to estimate self-excitation parameters.
candidate.grounding_rationale: Hawkes processes model temporal clustering of extreme volatility events.
candidate.testable_falsification_condition: Maximum drawdown reduction fails to achieve 20% vs passive carry.

backtest_spec.entry_condition: Reduce carry exposure to 0 when estimated self-excitation branching ratio alpha/beta exceeds 0.85 computed on trailing 288-bar M5 window.
backtest_spec.exit_condition: Restore standard position size when branching ratio decays below 0.40 for 6 consecutive M5 intervals.
backtest_spec.feature_engineering: Binary exceedance events defined as abs(return_t) > 2.0 * rolling_std_288; exponential kernel estimation of alpha and beta via maximum likelihood.
backtest_spec.risk_management: Binary de-risking: 0% exposure during high excitation, 100% normal exposure otherwise.

adjudication_notes: Sound risk-management spec using an explicit computable M5 bar exceedance proxy for point events.

candidate.title: Cross-Session Invariant Risk Minimization for Directional Return
candidate.target_phenomenon: Predictor performance decay under inter-session regime shifts
candidate.claim: Learning representation vectors that satisfy invariant gradient optimality across Asian, European, and US trading sessions reduces out-of-sample prediction error.
candidate.proposed_mechanism: Minimizing empirical cross-entropy while penalizing squared gradient norm of linear classifier across distinct trading session environments.
candidate.grounding_rationale: Arjovsky et al. (2019) Invariant Risk Minimization framework for out-of-distribution generalization.
candidate.testable_falsification_condition: Out-of-sample directional accuracy fails to exceed standard ERM baseline by 3.0 percentage points with p < 0.05.

backtest_spec.entry_condition: Go long when invariant predictor output f(x) > 0.65; go short when f(x) < 0.35 at session opening bars.
backtest_spec.exit_condition: Close trade on opposite signal or when trailing stop of 25 pips is breached.
backtest_spec.feature_engineering: M5 log returns, 14-period RSI, Garman-Klass volatility, and signed volume momentum partitioned into Asian (UTC 0-8), European (UTC 8-16), and US (UTC 16-24) environments.
backtest_spec.risk_management: Fixed risk allocation of 1.0% equity per trade.
backtest_spec.benchmark_baseline: Standard Empirical Risk Minimization (ERM) linear model.
backtest_spec.falsification_metric: Out-of-sample Sharpe ratio < ERM baseline Sharpe.

adjudication_notes: Sound IRM representation spec using native M5 OHLCV features and explicit session environments.

candidate.title: Bipower Variation Jump Filtering for Dynamic Carry Hedging
candidate.target_phenomenon: Abrupt currency crash risk during Poisson jump episodes
candidate.analogical_source: Jump Diffusion and Threshold Bipower Variation
candidate.claim: Disentangling Brownian diffusive volatility from compound Poisson jump variance via threshold bipower variation dynamically shields USDJPY carry portfolios.
candidate.proposed_mechanism: Calculating continuous bipower variation and jump component on M5 returns to infer regime transition probabilities via a 2-state Markov chain.
candidate.grounding_rationale: Mancini (2009) threshold estimation separates jump components from diffusive Gaussian volatility.
candidate.testable_falsification_condition: Maximum drawdown reduction fails to achieve 25% vs unhedged carry baseline.

backtest_spec.entry_condition: Maintain baseline long carry trade when filtered tranquil regime probability P(S_t = 0 | F_t) > 0.75.
backtest_spec.exit_condition: Liquidate all carry positions immediately if jump indicator J_t = (RV_t - BV_t) exceeds 1.5 * BV_t or if tranquil regime probability drops below 0.50.
backtest_spec.feature_engineering: Realized variance RV_t and bipower variation BV_t computed from trailing 288 M5 return bars.
backtest_spec.risk_management: Dynamic deleveraging from 1.0x to 0.0x based on jump probability.

adjudication_notes: Sound jump-diffusion risk-control spec using computable bipower variation on M5 bars.
